post.description: Completes the selected request even after its deadline, and exchanges expired non-target requests atomically. Omit quest_id or send an empty string for renewal only, without consuming materials or granting rewards. Renewal uses now > expires_at and never seeds an empty store. Successful calls return renewed_count (excluding the completion replacement); completion fields are present only for a completed target. Fetch GET /helpers/quests after success. A rejected completion leaves the board and assets unchanged.

quest_id.description: Target request ID. Omitted or empty means renewal only.

200.description: Completion or renewal-only result; renewed_count counts expired non-target exchanges

400.description: Bad request - invalid input or JSON syntax

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid session token

403.description: Forbidden - player does not own requested character or lacks permission

422.description: Completion rejected (for example insufficient materials, guild membership required, unknown or completed target); board and assets unchanged.

get.description: Read-only board of all uncompleted requests, including expired requests; completed requests are excluded. Expired targets can still be completed. For renewal without turn-in, POST /helpers/complete with character_id and omit quest_id or send an empty string, then fetch this board again after success. An empty board returns [] and is never seeded.

200.description: Uncompleted helper quests, including expired requests

400.description: Bad request - invalid input or JSON syntax
